notes.title: EXIT 3 - Painter
notes.content:
[b]Introducing the next episode of the series, EXIT 3 - Painter.[/b]
Coming live on 20th, Nov, 2017.

If you enjoyed EXIT and EXIT 2 you won't get disappointed.

Go and check out the gameplay trailer to find out more about how painting works in action:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/730670/EXIT_3__Painter/
